_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::beams#4, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. HERMITE_CENTERLINE true does add three tangent DOFs per node (6 -> 9), and upstream beam3r_herm2line2_static_test1 carries NUMDOF 9 with nine-entry ONOFF/VAL/FUNCT vectors. But cutting the Dirichlet block back to NUMDOF 6 does NOT produce an under-constrained run with 'spurious tangent growth at constrained nodes' — nothing is silent. The DBC reader aborts before the first step with '6 DOFs given but 9 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition' from core/fem/src/discretization/4C_fem_discretization_utils_dbc.cpp, the same check that guards beams#1 in the opposite direction. SIX_STEPS_TAKEN=0 pins that no time step happens. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
expect_in_output: 6 DOFs given but 9 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep NUMDOF 9 on the Hermite deck. Both arms then run to completion, the DOF-count diagnostic vanishes and the second arm exits 0, so the fixture must go red.
